detail.longDescription:
Line VPN is a fast, secure and free VPN for Android. Connect with one tap to high-speed servers and enjoy a private, encrypted and reliable connection with unlimited bandwidth on Wi-Fi and mobile data.

Key features:
• Easy to use – secure your connection with just one tap
• Free, unlimited bandwidth – no data caps
• Large network of high-speed servers
• No sign-up or registration required
• Optimized for Android devices
• Stable connection on Wi-Fi, 4G and 5G

Speed and performance:
• Fast, smooth browsing on websites and apps
• Low latency for online gaming
• Seamless switching across different networks
• Adaptive connection optimization for the best speed

Privacy and security:
• OpenVPN encryption (UDP/TCP)
• Built-in DNS protection
• No activity logs saved
• Secure browsing on public Wi-Fi hotspots

Line VPN uses Android's VpnService to create an encrypted tunnel between your device and our servers.
